summary: Iteration 3 — 7-loaf catalogue, festive boxes, save & share, real WhatsApp number. Full backend + frontend regression executed against production preview URL. 10/10 pytest backend tests pass. All 12 frontend flows pass (matchmaker for Eid/Graduation/Baby-born occasions, save-link roundtrip, festive boxes, cart, box builder, WhatsApp handoff, AI chat, surprise, mobile responsive).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: match endpoint's safety-net fallback correctly guards against LLM leaking other loaf names — verified via 3 parametrised match tests.
server.py: /api/match/{id} correctly excludes MongoDB _id from response.
App.js is now ~577 lines; approaching the 700-line threshold — consider splitting Cart drawer, Chat drawer, and Match/Builder sections into their own components in a future iteration.
waLink() uses wa.me which redirects to api.whatsapp.com in browsers; the phone (923224112832) and text payload are preserved through the redirect. No action needed.
seed_data_creation: None — saved_matches docs are created transiently during test_save_and_get_match_roundtrip.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_public_api.py covers: root, 7-loaf catalogue, banana bread walnut addon, 5 festive boxes with hydrated items+correct totals, 3 parametrised match combos with strict name-leak guard, save+GET roundtrip (10-char hex id), 404 on unknown match id, 404 on save with unknown product_id, chat happy path. Frontend Playwright confirmed: matchmaker Eid→Coconut Loaf, share URL restoration works via ?match= query, Eid box adds coconut+apple+lemon (cart_total=3350), builder 2×lemon+1×apple=3350, WhatsApp popups fire to phone=923224112832 (URL is api.whatsapp.com/send after wa.me redirect — treat as PASS), AI chat replies with catalogue-only names, .nav-links hides at 400px width. Nothing broken to retest.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs found this iteration.
